title.zh: 扩散模型在分子生成中的应用

summary.zh: 该论文提出了一种基于扩散模型的分子生成框架，能够高效地探索化学空间并生成具有理想属性的新型分子结构。
summary.en: This paper proposes a diffusion model-based framework for molecular generation, efficiently exploring chemical space to generate novel molecular structures with desired properties.

core_points.zh:
1. 提出了一种新的分子图扩散过程
2. 在QM9数据集上达到SOTA
3. 支持条件生成（性质导向）
core_points.en:
1. Novel molecular graph diffusion process
2. State-of-the-art results on QM9 benchmark
3. Supports conditional generation (property-guided)

title.zh: 大型语言模型的推理能力涌现
title.en: Emergent Reasoning in Large Language Models

summary.zh: 本研究系统性地分析了LLM中推理能力的涌现现象，发现模型规模超过某个阈值后，链式推理能力会出现显著提升。
summary.en: This study systematically analyzes the emergence of reasoning capabilities in LLMs, finding that chain-of-thought reasoning improves dramatically beyond a certain model scale threshold.

core_points.zh:
1. 推理能力在特定规模阈值后涌现
2. 提出了评估推理涌现的量化指标
3. 分析表明训练数据质量比数量更重要
core_points.en:
1. Reasoning emerges beyond specific scale thresholds
2. Quantitative metrics for measuring emergence
3. Training data quality matters more than quantity

title.en: Efficient Vision Transformer via Architecture Search

summary.zh: 本文提出了一种自动化的视觉Transformer架构搜索方法，在保持高精度的同时显著降低了计算开销。
summary.en: This paper introduces an automated architecture search method for Vision Transformers, significantly reducing computational costs while maintaining high accuracy.

core_points.zh:
1. 可微分架构搜索适用于ViT
2. 发现的架构比DeiT快3倍
3. 在ImageNet上达到同等精度
core_points.en:
1. Differentiable architecture search adapted for ViT
2. Discovered architectures 3x faster than DeiT
3. Comparable accuracy on ImageNet

title.zh: 基于强化学习的代码生成优化
title.en: Code Generation Optimization with Reinforcement Learning

summary.zh: 该工作利用强化学习来优化代码生成模型的输出，通过执行反馈信号提高生成代码的正确性和效率。
summary.en: This work leverages reinforcement learning to optimize code generation model outputs, improving correctness and efficiency through execution feedback signals.

core_points.zh:
1. 使用执行结果作为奖励信号
2. 在HumanEval上Pass@k提升15%
3. 生成的代码运行时效率更高
core_points.en:
1. Execution results as reward signals
2. 15% improvement on HumanEval Pass@k
3. Generated code is more runtime-efficient

title.zh: 多模态学习中的知识融合策略
title.en: Knowledge Fusion Strategies in Multimodal Learning

summary.zh: 本文综述了多模态学习中知识融合的最新策略，并提出了一种统一的融合框架来整合视觉、语言和听觉信息。
summary.en: This paper surveys recent knowledge fusion strategies in multimodal learning and proposes a unified fusion framework integrating visual, linguistic, and auditory information.

core_points.zh:
1. 系统的多模态融合方法分类
2. 提出了统一融合架构
3. 在多个基准上验证了有效性
core_points.en:
1. Systematic taxonomy of fusion methods
2. Unified fusion architecture proposed
3. Validated across multiple benchmarks
